title: tc-panel-card
description: A compact card for one section of a side panel, which folds or opens something else.

value.description: Short text at the right, such as a count

mode.description: "fold" opens and shuts the content; "link" makes the whole row a button that fires tc-open

expanded.description: Whether the content shows, in "fold" mode

bare.description: Drops the tray and shadow, for a card that sits in something else's surface
